name: M80
summary: M80 is a Laifual high-voltage rotary joint module with AC 220 V supply. It integrates a harmonic reducer, motor and encoder in a flange-mounted assembly with a central passage. Laifual positions this AC family for industrial motion applications using an external servo drive; the selected reduction ratio determines the torque and speed ratings.

description.en: M80 is a Laifual high-voltage rotary joint module with AC 220 V supply. It integrates a harmonic reducer, motor and encoder in a flange-mounted assembly with a central passage. Laifual positions this AC family for industrial motion applications using an external servo drive; the selected reduction ratio determines the torque and speed ratings.
